usage: tr grade [-h] [--session SESSION] [--dry-run] [--judge]
                [--judge-max-usd JUDGE_MAX_USD] [--batch | --collect BATCH_ID]

options:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit
  --session SESSION     a completed session (default: the latest, after 16:15
                        ET)
  --dry-run             print what would be created or graded; write nothing
  --judge               also run the P1 judge (openai/gpt-6-sol, one paid call
                        per graded thesis without a verdict; off by default)
  --judge-max-usd JUDGE_MAX_USD
                        dollar cap for the whole judge run (default: 0.25)
  --batch               with --judge: submit the judge calls as one OpenRouter
                        batch at the :batch price; nothing is stored until
                        --collect
  --collect BATCH_ID    with --judge: poll a submitted batch once and store
                        its verdicts when it is complete
